proceedings.supporting_quote: on 5 October 1995 property belonging to the applicant - the ship Stavanger and a floating drydock - was frozen on the order of the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office
On 21 April 1997 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court found the applicant guilty on some of the charges
In July 1997 the Supreme Court quashed the conviction on the applicant’s appeal and remitted the case to the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court
On 30 March 1998, during the new trial, the prosecutor applied to the court to detain the applicant... The Regional Court rejected the motion as unsubstantiated.
On 1 April 1998 the local electoral committee declared the elections invalid
The reply from the Supreme Court, dated 19 May 1998, stated that the national law did not allow appeals against that type of trial court orders separately
On 27 May 1998 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court found the applicant guilty on charges of misappropriation and embezzlement
On 10 August 1998 the Supreme Court confirmed the judgment of the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court
